question: What is behind View Layouts: when it is on, what the Layouts panel lists, what a pick does.
page: Blocks Probe, unsaved, a new blank section filled with blocks. Left by Exit Without Saving. Layouts picked in the panel; nothing outside the page pressed.

answers.on: On for a section with text, images or buttons, off for a blank section and for one holding only a Shape. It is not the template list: it holds the section's own blocks, re-laid out.
answers.pick: Sets every block's area on desktop and phones, the row count, the heading tag, and on some layouts the section's theme, divider or height. The panel stays open and the tile is marked. One undo step each. An empty text block and a Shape are dropped; other block types not read.
answers.lists: The list depends on the text, image and button blocks: 6 for a heading and a paragraph, 7 with an image and a button too, 14 for a heading and two images. The first read of a long list can show its tiles at 1285 for a moment; every read after a pick shows 1276.5.

notRead: Any other mix of blocks, or a mix with a block type other than text, image and button: ours stays off where the oracle may be on.
The tiles are real small copies of the section on the oracle; ours draws them from the same boxes, with no divider.
The panel top while the page scrolls with the panel open: Edit Section's comes along with its button (SECTIONBAR.json), ours leaves this one where it opened.
A divider shape other than the first as the start.
Whether a theme turn also holds for the Paragraph mix's layouts: read on the Image mix only.
Undo past the panel's opening, and undo by keyboard with the panel open: ours starts over from the section's look then.
Which tile is marked on opening a section that already matches a layout: ours marks none.

shape.reads: The same list as heading, paragraph, button. A pick removes the Shape. A section of Shapes alone has View Layouts off.

priorState.page: Blocks Probe, unsaved, a new section with an Image block (10 layouts), and an Image and Button (7 layouts). Theme, Height and Divider set first in Edit Section.
priorState.rule: A pick works from what the section had on opening the panel, not from the last pick. A layout with no style of its own puts all three back. Closing and opening again makes the current look the new start.
priorState.themeTurnRead: Layouts 8 and 9 of the Image mix, each start. The '' start is the first reading, on the Image and Paragraph mixes.

divider.note: The Divider on at its first shape. A press on Wavy Shape did not change the path's head, so another shape as the start is not settled.

closes.a press on a block: yes, and the block is selected
closes.a press on Edit Section: yes, and nothing opens: the section's own buttons take no press while the panel is open, and View Layouts itself is under the panel

staysOpen.Undo: The section goes back, the tile's mark goes. The panel does not move.
staysOpen.Redo: The section comes back, the mark too.

panelTop.rule: It opens where Edit Section's panel does (SECTIONBAR.json, panelTop): the two panels read the same at every height read together (562, 603.1, 644.2, 685.3, 726.4). All the reads below fit that rule with two changes to it, within 1.5px.

changesToTheRule.shortSection: A section under about 640 tall lets the panel hang out by more: 121 under the section's top at 562 tall, 134 at 603.1, whether the section is at the window's top or scrolled. Between those two a straight line, inferred. Under 562 not read. From 644.2 up it is the old limit: section bottom + 1 - 476.
changesToTheRule.lowStep: The step to the hanging-out line comes before Edit's top reaches H - 240: a read at 758 is on the line (731), and 751 is not (524, SECTIONBAR.json). Ours takes H - 245. Where in 751 to 758 is not read.

panelTop.viewLayoutsCentre: cases hold the View Layouts button's centre as read, Edit Section's top is 72.04 above it (222.6 and 294.64 read together).

cases.reads: Real mouse hover at each scroll, or the helper's hover, which scrolls. A second section 857.7 tall and first sections 562 and 808.5 tall. Row Count was typed by script for heights, then the panel opened by a real press.

panelTop.repeats: At 562 tall, every open read 176: six in a row in one run, one each in 4 more runs. Reads at 0, 400, 800 and 1400 ms after a press are the same.

afterPick.settled: The 195 is not a second open at 562. It is the panel after the first pick, with the panel still open.

reads.run: 2, the same at 0.1 to 6 s, and after 2 more picks

afterPick.rule: A first pick from a short section moves the panel down once, and it stays there through later picks until it closes. Opening again goes by the new height (272 at 726.4 and more). Ours takes 195, 140 under the section's top, from under 644 tall. Inferred: the one reading of 214 stays unexplained, so ours can be 19px off there.
afterPick.notRead: A first pick from a short section away from the window's top.
